name: body extension
description: A kneeling lean-back that stretches and strengthens the front of the thighs and the core.
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
